name: Palau-solità i Plegamans (Spain)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, with the black shovel of the arms at the centre of the white half and the white hand of the arms at the centre of the red half.
history: The flag was approved in 1998 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 6 April 1999; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, vertical bicolour white and red, with the black shovel of the arms on the white half and the white hand on the red half, both 4/6 of the height, representing the two villages united in the municipality, Palau-solità and Plegamans.
